CheckTitle: Supabase project has Point-in-Time Recovery enabled
Description: **Supabase projects** are assessed for **Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR)**, which archives WAL continuously so the database can be restored to any second instead of only to the last daily backup.
Risk: Without PITR a destructive migration, ransomware style data wipe or compromised service key means **losing up to a day of data**, and recovery is limited to coarse daily snapshots, increasing the blast radius of any security incident.

Code.Other:
1. Open the Supabase Dashboard and select the project
2. Go to Project Settings > Add-ons (or Database > Backups)
3. Enable the Point in Time Recovery add-on and choose a retention period
4. Document the restore procedure and test it

Recommendation.Text: Enable PITR on every production project and rehearse restores; keep daily backups for non-production workloads.

Notes: PITR is a paid add-on; the check reports FAIL on free projects so teams can decide whether the data warrants it.
